fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. v0.37.4 is the final diagnostic build for OCum Ascended 3D equip-object meshes: it preserves supported RaceMenu CumOverlays synchronization and adds explicit OStim return-state diagnostics for ocumvagmesh/ocumanmesh. The log now records the bool returned by OActor.EquipObject plus OActor.IsObjectEquipped readback at T250 and T1250 on the remote STR proxy. OCum 3D meshes remain experimental and are not part of the supported feature set pending this final validation. Local OCum rendering, PPA, scene anchors and alignment are unchanged.
